name: The majority voted against One Nation amendments on sheets [2131](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7011_amend_989e1420-5062-4652-a71b-efeaf7522dfd%22;rec=0) and [2135](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7011_amend_661a61ae-d3a6-4b84-8aa2-0129fce4ef86%22;rec=0), which means they failed. There was one rebel voted, with Queensland Senator [Gerard Rennick](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/gerard_rennick) (Liberal) voting "Yes" against the rest of the Liberal Party.
